programme.title: Burn Pile Murder Trial
programme.desc: According to prosecutors in their opening statements, money was the motive for this murder. Next, Melody Farris' defense delivered their opening remarks to the jury. A complicated family coupled with a complicated police investigation all led to fingers pointing at Melody Farris for first-degree murder.
